issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Ross - Judgment in a Criminal Case (Sharon Ross), ECF 68
supports: Judgment as to Sharon Ross orders mandatory restitution of $2,434,360.00 payable to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, due immediately, with payments of not less than $100 per month beginning 30 days after release.
The judgment forfeits the defendant's interest in all items listed in the preliminary and final orders of forfeiture.
does_not_support: It does not show any payment or collection.
It states no forfeiture dollar amount itself; see the Preliminary Order of Forfeiture (ECF 55).
